children: Midsona invites you to a presentation of the company’s interim report January-September 2026 on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 11.00 am CEST. The report will be published the same day at 08.00 am CEST.
President and CEO Henrik Hjalmarsson and CFO Niclas Lundin will present the results. After the presentation, there will be an opportunity to ask questions. The presentation will be held in English.

Midsona develops and markets strong brands within health and well-being, with products that help people live a healthier and more sustainable life, with an increased understanding of the origin of the raw material and with transparency as to the content. The Midsona share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information www.midsonagroup.com.
